:::{#def-preimage}
#### Preimage, inverse image

Let $f : A \to B$ be a [function](#def-function),
and let $S$ be a [subset](sets.qmd#def-subset) of $B$.
The **preimage**
[@wikipedia_image_mathematics]
(also called the **inverse image**)
of $S$ under $f$
is the [set](sets.qmd#def-set) of elements of $A$ whose [values](#def-value) are in $S$:

$$f^{-1}(S) \eqdef \set{a \in A : f(a) \in S}$$

:::
